meta.name: Little Things
meta.description:
A cohabiting couple in their 20s navigate the ups and downs of work, modern-day relationships and finding themselves in contemporary Bengaluru.

Ended · First aired 25 Oct 2016 · India · Language: Hindi · 20 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 8/8 | S3 8/8 | S4 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: FOMO
videos.overview: Jealous of their friends’ exciting social media updates, Kavya and Dhruv try to have their own fun, but can't agree on what to do.

videos.title: Have A Nice Day
videos.overview: After a careless mistake gets Kavya into trouble at work and Dhruv is faced with a professional disappointment of his own, the two reconvene at home.

videos.title: Good Night
videos.overview: A sleepless night proves surprisingly eventful for Kavya and Dhruv, with an impromptu store run, an unexpected encounter and a midnight chat.

videos.title: Thank You!
videos.overview: After a long-awaited dinner turns out to be disappointing, Dhruv reluctantly accompanies Kavya to a friend's party.

videos.title: Here We Go!
videos.overview: A food craving takes Kavya and Dhruv on a road trip to the countryside, where the fresh air inspires them to do some soul-searching.

videos.title: Milk Cake
videos.overview: When an old friend comes to visit from Delhi, Dhruv is struck by how much has changed between them since their childhood.

videos.title: Back Seat
videos.overview: After Kavya gets a big work promotion and Dhruv makes a difficult professional decision, they attend the housewarming party of a well-to-do couple.

videos.title: Cheeti Aur Haathi
videos.overview: Kavya gets busier at work while managing a big project. Feeling restless at home, Dhruv struggles to find ways to bring in some income.

videos.title: Mumbai Darshan
videos.overview: When Kavya’s mother comes to visit, Dhruv takes her out for the afternoon and learns more about the person behind the parent.

videos.title: Leicester City F.C.
videos.overview: When Kavya hits it off with another man on a work trip, she begins questioning whether her relationship with Dhruv is good enough for the long haul.

videos.title: Bed & Breakfast
videos.overview: With Kavya feeling under the weather, weekend plans are canceled in favor of a day at home, where she and Dhruv chill, chat and occasionally quarrel.

videos.title: Baalti Aur Magga
videos.overview: While attending a friend’s wedding, a moment of intimacy between Kavya and Dhruv devolves into a full-blown argument about where they stand.

videos.title: Where Are We?
videos.overview: Following their fight, Kavya and Dhruv return home from the wedding, stopping at a familiar place for a heart-to-heart talk.

videos.title: Migration
videos.overview: A research stint takes Dhruv to Bangalore. As Kavya helps him settle in, unease over their upcoming months apart affects their remaining hours together.

videos.title: Today of all Days
videos.overview: Dhruv quickly takes to his new surroundings and makes instant friends. Kavya struggles with loneliness at home and vulnerability at work.

videos.title: Rectangles
videos.overview: Dhruv and Kavya grow accustomed to their individual lives. As Dhruv's fellowship ends, an awkward conversation stirs unease about his return to Mumbai.

videos.title: Senior Citizens
videos.overview: While visiting her hometown in Nagpur, Kavya's interactions with her ageing parents and childhood friends spark both concern and nostalgia.

videos.title: Vertical Housing
videos.overview: Dhruv visits Delhi to help his mother pack up his childhood home, but pressure to marry and family tensions have him feeling frustrated and detached.

videos.title: Jet Lag
videos.overview: The couple are finally reunited, but life seems out of sync as Dhruv compares Mumbai to Bangalore and feels replaced by Kavya's new friendships.

videos.title: The Sum of our Past
videos.overview: Flashbacks illuminate each of Dhruv's and Kavya's early encounters with relationships and marriage. In the present day, a wedding ring triggers tension.

videos.title: Migration II
videos.overview: Dhruv envies a friend's accomplishment. As sad news compels Kavya to consider transferring to Nagpur, the couple reflect on their evolving relationship.

videos.title: Circles
videos.overview: Reunited after 14 months, Kavya and Dhruv reflect on their time apart, wondering if the physical distance created an emotional disconnection, too.

videos.title: Family Holiday
videos.overview: On their Kerala holiday, Kavya talks a reluctant Dhruv into taking a bus tour, but the day trip isn’t without a few bumps in the road.

videos.title: Fort Kavya
videos.overview: When Dhruv is unable to get out of a work commitment on Kavya’s 30th birthday, she spends the occasion in her own company, exploring and soul-searching.

videos.title: Air Quality Index
videos.overview: Kavya makes a brave career move. A meetup with Dhruv’s friends from Finland sparks questions about the future and why Dhruv really moved back to India.

videos.title: Business Class
videos.overview: While setting up their new home in Mumbai, Dhruv and Kavya discuss the pros and cons of marriage. An accident leads to a disappointing setback.

videos.title: Got Your Back
videos.overview: With Kavya listless at home and Dhruv struggling at work, three weeks pass before they realize the toll these things have taken on their relationship.

videos.title: What's This Party For?
videos.overview: While both sets of parents are visiting, Kavya and Dhruv host a gathering at home with friends — but no one is quite sure what the occasion is.

videos.title: Full Circle
videos.overview: In a merry mood, the couple enjoys a late night out, taking a pause to celebrate the present moment as they stand on the cusp of big things to come.
